import math
import sys

def chmax(a, b):
    if a < b:
        a = b
        return True
    return False

def chmin(a, b):
    if a > b:
        a = b
        return True
    return False

EPS = 1e-7
INF = 1e9
PI = math.acos(-1)
mod = 1000000007

N, K = map(int, sys.stdin.read().split())

def beki(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        return 1
    ret = beki(a, b // 2)
    ret = ret * ret
    if b & 1:
        ret *= a
    return ret

class Matrix:
    def __init__(self, n=0, m=0):
        if n == 0 and m == 0:
            self.A = []
        elif m == 0:
            self.A = [[0 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
        else:
            self.A = [[0 for _ in range(m)] for _ in range(n)]
    @staticmethod
    def I(n):
        mat = Matrix(n)
        for i in range(n):
            mat[i][i] = 1
        return mat
    def height(self):
        return len(self.A)
    def width(self):
        return len(self.A[0]) if self.A else 0
    def __getitem__(self, k):
        return self.A[k]
    def __setitem__(self, k, value):
        self.A[k] = value
    def __iadd__(self, B):
        n, m = self.height(), self.width()
        assert n == B.height() and m == B.width()
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(m):
                self[i][j] = (self[i][j] + B[i][j]) % mod
        return self
    def __isub__(self, B):
        n, m = self.height(), self.width()
        assert n == B.height() and m == B.width()
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(m):
                self[i][j] = (self[i][j] - B[i][j] + mod) % mod
        return self
    def __imul__(self, B):
        n, m, p = self.height(), B.width(), self.width()
        assert p == B.height()
        C = [[0 for _ in range(m)] for _ in range(n)]
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(m):
                for k in range(p):
                    C[i][j] = (C[i][j] + self[i][k] * B[k][j]) % mod
        self.A = C
        return self
    def __pow__(self, k):
        result = Matrix.I(self.height())
        base = self
        while k > 0:
            if k & 1:
                result *= base
            base *= base
            k >>= 1
        return result
    def __add__(self, B):
        return Matrix(self.height(), self.width()).__iadd__(B)
    def __sub__(self, B):
        return Matrix(self.height(), self.width()).__isub__(B)
    def __mul__(self, B):
        return Matrix(self.height(), self.width()).__imul__(B)
    def __str__(self):
        s = ""
        for row in self.A:
            s += "[" + ",".join(map(str, row)) + "]\n"
        return s
    def determinant(self):
        B = Matrix(self.height(), self.width())
        for i in range(self.height()):
            B[i] = self[i][:]
        n = self.width()
        assert n == self.height()
        ret = 1
        for i in range(n):
            idx = -1
            for j in range(i, n):
                if B[j][i] != 0:
                    idx = j
                    break
            if idx == -1:
                return 0
            if i != idx:
                ret *= -1
                B[i], B[idx] = B[idx], B[i]
            ret *= B[i][i]
            vv = B[i][i]
            for j in range(n):
                B[i][j] /= vv
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                a = B[j][i]
                for k in range(n):
                    B[j][k] -= B[i][k] * a
        return ret
    def rot(self, K):
        B = Matrix(len(self.A), len(self.A[0]))
        for i in range(K):
            for j in range(K):
                B[i][j] = self[(i + K - 1) % K][(j + K - 1) % K]
            B[i][K] = self[(i + K - 1) % K][K]
            B[K][i] = self[K][(i + K - 1) % K]
        B[K][K] = self[K][K]
        self.A = B.A

mat = [[None for _ in range(35)] for _ in range(70)]

N, K = map(int, sys.stdin.read().split())

    INDEX += 1

# Build initial matrices

for i in range(1, K + 1):
    for j in range(K + 1):
        mat[0][0][0][j] = 1
for i in range(1, K):
    mat[0][i] = mat[0][i - 1]
    mat[0][i].rot(K)

for index in range(1, INDEX + 1):
    mat[index][0] = mat[index - 1][0]
    for i in range(1, K):
        mat[index][0] = mat[index][0] * mat[index - 1][i]
    for i in range(1, K):
        mat[index][i] = mat[index][i - 1]
        mat[index][i].rot(K)

# Initialize answer vector
ans = Matrix(K + 1, 1)
ans[K][0] = 1

used = 0
for current_index in range(INDEX, -1, -1):
    while True:
        if beki(K, current_index) <= N:
            N -= beki(K, current_index)
            ans = mat[current_index][used] * ans
            used = (used + 1) % K
        else:
            break

val = 0
for i in range(K + 1):
    val += ans[i][0]
val %= mod
